[[Miresh]] wishes to leave the cult of the Stone Face.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
* Travel to [[Zehlon Reach]] and talk to Tahon. 
* Defeat Tahon!
* See [[Kihawa]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
{{section-stub}}
Walk northwest until you come to the same spot where the Stone Face Cult always stand. Before talking to Tahon, it is advised that low level characters have some enchantments active since he is a level 12 monk. After killing him, travel to [[The Astralarium]] and talk to Kihawa to receive your reward.

==NPCs==
=== Foes ===
[[Human]]s
*{{mo}} 12 (20) [[Tahon]]
*{{w}} 7 (20) [[Istani Cultist]]s (several)
''Note:'' these turn hostile only after you talk to Tahon.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Miresh
:''"You know, you're right. I'm starting to think that this Stone Face business is a bunch of hooey. But Tahon's kind of scary…. Ok, I'll leave, but only if you're the one who's going to tell '''Tahon''' that I '''quit'''.  I need to go find my wife. I miss talking to her… even the arguments. "''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Glad you saw the light Miresh. I'll go tell him.
| decline = Do it yourself. I'm not your messenger!
| ask = Go speak with '''Tahon''' in '''Zehlon Reach''' for me.  I've got to go apologize to my wife.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Tahon'''
:''"What?! Miresh is leaving? This is all your fault, isn't it? You talked him into leaving! Your presence defiles this land, you pretender! The Order of the Stone Face will not stand for such disrespect. You will be crushed between teeth of granite!!"''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Kihawa'''
:''"I was so worried about Miresh. Without Tahon, that cult will fall apart and we can finally tear down that ridiculous stone face and line our walkway with it. Thank you so much!"''
